dataItem-mph6m3mr.text: For RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell:

dataItem-mph6m3n8.text: I also imported the animated daffodils into Unreal Engine on the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation. However, the daffodils still lacked materials, as mentioned previously. Additionally, the Level Sequence dropped frames during playback, making it impossible to play the full animation smoothly. Despite these issues, the FPS performance was notably better than on the RTX 4090.
